title: Tecsys TS9090-ASI/IP Converter
excerpt: TS9090-ASI / IP is a standalone ASI-IP encapsulation module and IP packet converter for DVB ASI. It can be used for unicast / multicast transmissions, supporting streams up to 150Mbits with UDP or RTP protocol. It also has automatic identifier for packets of 188 bytes or TS 204 bytes (including ISDB-T BTS). With an easy-to-configure graphical interface the TS 9090-ASI / IP is the complete tool for integrating digital links, UpLinks and Headends.
body:
TS9090-ASI / IP is a standalone ASI-IP encapsulation module and IP packet converter for DVB ASI. It can be used for unicast / multicast transmissions, supporting streams up to 150Mbits with UDP or RTP protocol. It also has automatic identifier for packets of 188 bytes or TS 204 bytes (including ISDB-T BTS). With an easy-to-configure graphical interface the TS 9090-ASI / IP is the complete tool for integrating digital links, UpLinks and Headends.

Main Features:

DVB-ASI data rates from 100Kb / s to 150Mb / s DVB-ASI packet size 188 byte or 204 packet-detection byte

MPEG Configurable as receiver or transmitter
